_about: Written by tools/import_zone_kit.gd from data/source/final_kit.csv and the art in C:/Dev/Deckbuilder-rpg/_art_inbox/batch11/Approved_ZoneKits/Capital: one entry per kit id with its lock, family (group / slot), prepared size, pivot (0..1 of the trimmed image), tile size in metres at 400 px/m, sheet parts. EnvKit reads it: every id here resolves like an Environment Kit id (assets/art/zone_kits/final/<ID>.webp). Hand-added keys (height, width, tile, placeholder, slot) survive a re-import; entries not on the sheet (aliases) are kept.

CAP-BD-CITY.desc: INSIDE. A distant perfectly symmetrical pastel skyline with white-and-gold spires.

CAP-BD-LANTERNS.use: The freed Capital's sky over the castle

CAP-BD-PALACE.asset: The palace skyline from the Gate Road
CAP-BD-PALACE.use: Gate Road / outside the wall backdrop

CAP-BD-WASTELAND.desc: OUTSIDE. Distant ruined hills, dead forests, and faint purple rifts on the horizon, hazy.

CAP-DEC-ASH.desc: OUTSIDE. Soft gray ash drifts seen from above, fading edges.

CAP-DEC-SHINE.desc: INSIDE. A soft, unnaturally perfect gloss highlight seen from above, fading edges.

CAP-FX-FIREWORKS.use: The freed Capital's sky over the castle

CAP-GROUND-RIFT.desc: OUTSIDE. Dark cracked ground veined with a faint purple glow.

CAP-HERO-CORRECTION-WARD.desc: INSIDE. A gleaming, cheerful-looking white building that is quietly sinister: barred mirrored windows, a smiling Primm sign (emblem only), a perfect lawn with no one on it.

CAP-HERO-GRAVE-ROW.desc: INSIDE. A tidy white cemetery lane with identical headstones. Show TWO states: BROKEN (restless ghosts drifting, unfiled paperwork blowing about, open graves) and RESTORED (calm, softly glowing green lanterns, flowers, peaceful).

CAP-HERO-GREAT-WALL-GATE.desc: OUTSIDE. The huge, flawless white wall around the city with an enormous gold-trimmed gate, a smiling Primm emblem above it; perfect and pristine against the ruined ashen land in front of it, a few cracks starting to show.
CAP-HERO-GREAT-WALL-GATE.use: The wall between the two halves, seen from outside

CAP-HERO-IDENTICAL-ROW.desc: INSIDE. A row of perfectly identical pastel houses with identical bakeries. Show TWO states: BROKEN (empty shelves, cold ovens, grey uniform food paste in windows) and RESTORED (warm ovens, real colorful food, copper and cream Gourmand touches).

CAP-HERO-PRIMM-FOUNTAIN.desc: INSIDE. The hub centerpiece: a pristine white marble fountain topped by a grand statue of Primm smiling benevolently, arms spread, gold accents, perfectly symmetrical water jets.

CAP-HERO-PRIMMS-CASTLE.desc: INSIDE. The final goal of the whole game: an immense, gleaming white-and-gold palace on a hill at the heart of the city, perfectly symmetrical, with soaring spires, mirrored windows, a grand stair, and a colossal smiling Primm emblem over the doors. Hairline cracks and faint purple rift light leak from it. Magnificent and cold; must be visible from both halves of the Capital and over the walls from far outside.

CAP-HERO-RESISTANCE-CAMP.desc: OUTSIDE. A small, warm hidden camp of patched tents and salvaged crates around a campfire, colorful scraps from all four Paths stitched into the tents; the only warm light in the wasteland.

CAP-HERO-RIFT.desc: OUTSIDE. A jagged vertical tear in reality hovering just above cracked ground, glowing bright purple at the edges with darkness inside, floating shards of stone and crystal around it.

CAP-HERO-SERVICE-TUNNEL.desc: OUTSIDE. A heavy old iron hatch and arched tunnel mouth set into the base of the great wall, overgrown and forgotten, a dim lantern beside it.

CAP-HERO-THE-REEK.desc: INSIDE. The city's back lane where refuse should be collected. Show TWO states: BROKEN (overflowing bins hidden behind a perfect painted screen, flies, grime) and RESTORED (clean compost bins, a little community garden, moss and wildflowers).

CAP-HERO-TRAM-SHED.desc: INSIDE. A long white-and-gold tram shed with pastel trams. Show TWO states side by side: BROKEN (lights dead, trams stalled, a giant unturned wheel, eerie stillness) and RESTORED (lights on, trams running, the Beefcake wheel crews cheerful, red-gold touches).

CAP-HERO-WATCHTOWER.desc: OUTSIDE. A tall ruined stone watchtower of the old kingdom, top half collapsed, a tattered old banner of the four Paths still clinging to it.

CAP-PATH-WHITE.desc: INSIDE. A clean white paved road with a thin gold center line.

CAP-PLANT-CRYSTAL.desc: OUTSIDE. A cluster of glowing purple rift crystals growing from cracked ground.

CAP-PLANT-ROSE.desc: INSIDE. A perfectly trimmed bed of identical pink roses in a white planter.

CAP-PROP-BENCH.desc: INSIDE. A pastel bench with gold armrests, exactly like all the others.

CAP-PROP-CAMPFIRE.desc: OUTSIDE. A small warm campfire ringed with stones, a kettle hanging over it.

CAP-PROP-LAMP.desc: INSIDE. A pastel lamppost with a gold cap and a perfectly round lamp.
